note: The dossier fields that NEED a sourced claim (stocks/EVIDENCE.md §4, the research brief's list). One file, read by stocks/lib/evidence.mjs for the builders and fetched by stocks.js for the page, so the coverage number on a card, in stocks-issuers.json and in the issuer panel can never be three different numbers. A `*` segment is a wildcard expanded against the record's own keys at read time; a path counts as needed only when the record actually carries a value there, because a field with nothing in it has nothing to source.
